# Vendored Reveal runtime
Official `reveal.js@5.2.1` from npm, fetched with `npm pack reveal.js@5.2.1 --ignore-scripts`.
Upstream: https://github.com/hakimel/reveal.js ; MIT license in REVEAL-LICENSE.
`reveal.js` and `reveal.css` are the official dist artifacts. `reveal-bundle.js` exports their content as strings for identical browser and Node offline HTML export. Source-map comment excluded from bundle. No CDN, plugins, theme fonts, fetches, or module import are required by the generated file.
